name: taxsage
description: MSME tax collation, processing and reporting under the Nigeria Tax Act 2025

scripts.package:prototype: npm run build && rm -rf /tmp/txs-proto && mkdir -p /tmp/txs-proto/taxsage-prototype && cp -r dist /tmp/txs-proto/taxsage-prototype/ && cp prototype-assets/* /tmp/txs-proto/taxsage-prototype/ && chmod +x /tmp/txs-proto/taxsage-prototype/START-MAC-LINUX.sh /tmp/txs-proto/taxsage-prototype/server.js && cd /tmp/txs-proto && zip -r $OLDPWD/taxsage-prototype.zip taxsage-prototype && echo '✓ taxsage-prototype.zip rebuilt'
